title: Moving to a Friendly Number: 49 + 27
objective: Deliberately choose how much to move so that one addend becomes a clean benchmark (like 50), making the addition easier.
studentQuestion: How much would we need to move to make 49 into a nice, round number?
newIdea: Purposeful compensation — choosing the adjustment size to reach a specific friendly target, not moving an arbitrary amount.

teaching.see: 49 is so close to 50 — what if it were exactly 50?
teaching.transform: 49 + 27 and 50 + 26 — same total (76), a friendlier form.

check.prompt: Add the original numbers directly (or via a second method) to confirm 76.

mastery.evidence: Correctly compensates 49 + 27 and one further example without the give/take pairing error.
